title.description: A short name for the exercise, as a learner would see it.

rationale.description: Why this phrase suits the skill. Never shown to the learner.

step.description: The note letter. null is a rest.

beats.description: Written length in quarter-note beats. The enum is what keeps every bar notatable on a simple division grid.

chord.description: True when this note sounds together with the previous one instead of after it.

drum.description: Percussion only. Never send this for a pitched instrument.
